person_made_it: Yes: Gordon's own class links, every URL checked live on Oct 23, and two colleagues with titles from their own signatures.
emcee_who_is_speaking: Gordon, handing each student the card he'd give them in person.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Friday 3 PM, scanned from a lecture-hall seat as class ends.
did_the_click_pay_me: Yes: one scan gives every door, email and event from the hour.
works_for_the_recipient: One column, large tap targets, emails shown as text so they can be copied, dark mode for evening.
taught_me_something: That Industry Relations, a job board and two named people exist for them now, not senior year.
told_me_the_truth: Every link was tested; eligibility for Industry Week events is pointed to the official schedule, not promised.
weakest: No visual flourish; it is a utility card by design.
